notes.title: v1.20 Mako Mankanshoku joins the fight! (Nov 29 Update)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/98ac157ca37c874d3e181589ae24987f19a2ed12.jpg[/img]
[h1]Power-type tricky infighter, Mako Mankanshoku joins the fight![/h1]
Doning the Fight Club-spec Two-Star Goku Uniform, Mako joins the fight with her everlasting vitality! She displays her combat prowess by throwing her fists around while fumbling all over, and with her fast close combat attacks she makes for a formidable infighter in the ring!

She holds a unique ”Tension“ gauge to herself, where she powers up when the going gets smooth.

She's unstoppable when her tension gets maxed out!?
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/f50568d0276b1bf13aec164ca93d20b42b77c9ab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/c604644303d14a39862ab17348b9f84fd7f6e9b9.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/5f4b4cc1a1955e3b6c88b8d1a8b5d0524c4ec8bd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/fc5396db364577c3eb767a19356bbede527a7ad1.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/85ea30e87adf56fa10838a6e1da9846eee4aa6ab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/9b85543b129e760056fe4d190346425e3ea60091.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/59ac82a7d7af8524edd7167f5beaed6688d1eda7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35503150/cf8fbf92f96af9b7f860f22572b0fd47031d0c54.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Price change with effect from Oct 7, 2019
notes.notes:
Dear customers, 

We are pleased to inform that the price change has been approved and taken effect as of now, October 7th 2019. 
The price for the following currencies have been amended as follows:
USD: $59.99 to $39.99
MXN: 1,099p to 780p

The price change is to reflect price parity between all platforms concerned. 
Thank you for your cooperation and kind understanding.

notes.title: v1.03 Patch (Sep 18th)
notes.notes:
The following features have been implemented:
- Implemented console version's "v1.03" content. 
[i]*Will update with further details of the update when ready. We seek your kind patience on this matter.[/i]


[Game launcher updates]
- Game launcher now properly detects your computer's video cards and allows you to choose which video card to run the game in.
- Added a wider selection of display resolutions.

[PC Optimization Bug fixes]
- Fixed issue where game gets unnaturally stretched to weird propositions when applying full screen to a display resolution the monitor does not support natively, by introducing black borders.
- Fixed several instances where game crashes on specific computer environments.
